name: Desk Town
units: metres; game space: x right (red side +x), y up, z = -blender_y (blender north = game -z). Boxes [minX, minY, minZ, maxX, maxY, maxZ].

collider_kinds.walk: solid, top is walkable (decks, stairs, raised floors)
collider_kinds.rail: blocks players, bullets pass above 0.55 m (thin wooden rail): treat as solid for v1
collider_kinds.tear: tearable panel (solid while intact; the panel list has its geometry)
